scope: Covers W07 (startup failure reporting and per-data-root WebView2 profile) on a Windows 11 development machine. It does not replace the Windows 10 target-machine acceptance and does not close the unexplained 101 from 2026-11-03.

cases.name: webview2-unavailable
cases.setup: WEBVIEW2_BROWSER_EXECUTABLE_FOLDER points at an empty directory; isolated --data-dir

actual.log_text:
Image Studio 启动失败
时间（UTC）：2026-11-03T05:02:27Z
原因：Failed to setup app: runtime error: Could not find the webview runtime, make sure it is installed
日志：\\?\<data-root>\logs\startup-failure.log
建议：确认 Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime 已安装且可启动；确认数据根可写；仍失败时保留本文件供排查。

cases.name: two-roots-separate-webview-profiles
cases.setup: two simultaneous instances with different --data-dir roots
cases.expected: both instances run; each root owns its WebView2 profile; the legacy shared profile is not used

quality_gate.note: Development machine only; verification/windows-quality-gate.json stays bound to the Win10 target machine and was not rewritten.

reproduction_attempts.question: Does a second instance with a different --data-dir exit with code 101 as recorded on 2026-11-03?
attempts: first instance force-killed, 12 orphaned msedgewebview2 processes left, then second instance with a different root
reproduction_attempts.note: All scenarios kept both hosts running. The panic path itself was proven separately: any Tauri setup failure panics in tauri-2.12.5/src/app.rs:1444 and exits 101, which is why W07 reports the failure explicitly.
